newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF says supports BOJ plan to keep low rate policy.
newsitem.headline: MOF says supports BOJ plan to keep low rate policy.

text.p: Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka told a parliamentary committee meeting on Thursday that he supports the current policy of the Bank of Japan to maintain its low interest rate policy for the time being.

Mitsuzuka said BOJ Governor Yasuo Matsushita has said at parliamentary committee meetings that the economy is moving ahead firmly, but there still remains some residual impact from the April 1 increase in Japan's national sales tax.
"Governor Matsushita has also said the BOJ will maintain the current policy of low interest rates for the time being. I support the policy," he said.
